rules.text: Sika® CarboDur® M plates are pultruded carbon fibre reinforced polymer (CFRP) laminates, designed for strengthening concrete, timber, masonry, steel and fibre reinforced polymer structures
rules.heading: DESCRIPTION

rules.text: Sika® CarboDur® M plates are bonded onto the structure as externally bonded reinforcement using Sikadur®-30 epoxy resin based adhesive for normal, or Sikadur®-30 LP* epoxy resin based adhesive for elevated temperatures during application and / or service, long lead times and quantities apply
rules.heading: DESCRIPTION

rules.text: Sikadur®-30 LP* non stock item, lead times and minimum quantities apply
rules.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

rules.text: The system build-up and configuration as described must be fully complied with and may not be changed. Resin Adhesive - Sikadur®-30 or Sikadur®-30 LP*. Sikadur 30LP is a non stock item, lead times and minimum quantities apply. Structural strengthening Carbon plates – Sika® CarboDur® M. For detailed information on Sikadur®-30 and Sikadur®-30 LP*, together with the application details, please refer to the Sikadur®-30 or Sikadur®-30 LP* Product Data Sheet and the “Method Statement Sika® CarboDur® Externally Bonded Reinforcement” Ref: 850 41 05.
